title: dryopteris microlepis
intro: Dryopteris microlepis, commonly known as the Asian shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of D. microlepis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
